visual_experiences: ["Distortions (e.g., screen warping or rotating)","Simple shapes or patterns (e.g., ball of light, lines, grids, spiderwebs, geometric shapes)","Colors other than red and black"]
visual_description: I mostly just saw distortions, but there were periods of time where I felt like I saw a string of white diamond shapes (a pattern) all connected to eachother.  There were also periods when I would see a flowing wave of red accompanied by a greenish-blue (that also seemed to be flowing).  I also saw spinning.  Sometimes it would be chunky and staticky with the blue/green, but there were also periods where I felt like I saw a smooth circle/ wheel shape spinning.  It reminded me of/ looked a lot like a bicycle wheel (but it didn't definitively look like that).
emotional_experience: Somewhat unpleasant, but didn't mind going on
consciousness_changes: ["As if in a dreamlike state","Lost a sense of time","Lost a sense of space"]
consciousness_description: I did feel like I wasn't quite in the room--like I was being immersed somewhere else.  I felt like the screen was coming towards me and I was going inside of it.
